review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines one homeomorphism, orbitQuotientHomeomorph, and two simp lemmas about it. The definition is built from existing Mathlib pieces: Homeomorph.Quotient.congrRight, Topology.IsQuotientMap.homeomorph, MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient, Setoid.ker and ContinuousMap. I found no new structure or concept that competes with Mathlib. I also checked TauCeti/Topology/Homeomorph/Quotient.lean. It only adds the `_mk` evaluation lemmas for Mathlib's own congr and congrRight, and its docstring says so. A grep of the Mathlib topology directory found no existing statement of this orbit-quotient homeomorphism for the universal cover. I did not check the UniversalCover definitions in other TauCeti files.
